messages.subject: Re: is R shiny object oriented programming?
parts:
Like most web frameworks, the extent to which you take an OO approach is up to you.  You can implement as much OO using R as you like. See http://adv-r.had.co.nz/OO-essentials.html to learn about R's OO capabilities.

The framework itself just takes care of a lot of the messy stuff involved with creating a web app -- hurdles which are much higher when using R as compared to languages like PHP, Python, or Ruby.

When using Shiny, you simply need to conform to Shiny's API, which is quite flexible.  After that, it's up to you.
